name: Kontroller
tagline: Turn your phone into a wireless mouse and keyboard
description:
Kontroller lets you control your PC, Mac, TV, or tablet using your Android phone as a wireless mouse or keyboard over Bluetooth. It uses Android's built-in Bluetooth HID support, so there's no special software needed on the other device.

Handy for controlling a media center from the couch or giving quick input to a computer without reaching for a separate mouse.
